verses.text: Now, brothers and sisters, we want you to know about the grace God has given to the churches in Macedonia.
They have been tested by many troubles, and they are very poor. But their great joy has overflowed into rich giving.
I can tell you that they gave as much as they were able, and even more than they were able. They did it all by their own choice.
They begged us again and again for the joy of sharing in this gift for God's people.
They did more than we expected. First they gave themselves to the Lord, and then to us, as God wanted.
So we asked Titus to finish this kind work of giving among you, since he was the one who started it.
You do well in everything: in faith, in speaking, in knowledge, in eagerness to help, and in your love for us. So make sure you also do well in this kind work of giving.
I am not ordering you to do this. I want to test how real your love is, by comparing it with how eager others are.
You know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. He was rich, but for your sake he became poor, so that by his being poor you could become rich.
This is my advice about what is best for you. Last year you were the first not only to give, but also to want to give.
So now finish the work. Be as eager to finish it as you were to start it, and give from what you have.
If you are willing to give, God accepts your gift by what you have, not by what you do not have.
We do not want others to have an easy time while you have a hard time. We want things to be equal.
Right now you have plenty, and that can help those who are in need. Then, when they have plenty, they can help you when you are in need. In this way things will be equal.
As it is written, "The one who gathered a lot did not have too much, and the one who gathered a little did not have too little."
I thank God that he has put in the heart of Titus the same care for you that I have.
Titus welcomed our request, but he was so eager that he is coming to you by his own choice.
We are sending with him the brother whom all the churches praise for his work in preaching the good news.
And the churches also chose him to travel with us as we carry this gift. We do this to honour the Lord himself and to show how eager we are to help.
We want to be careful so that no one can find fault with how we handle this large gift.
We are trying to do what is right, not only in the Lord's eyes, but also in the eyes of people.
We are also sending with them our brother who has often shown us in many ways that he is eager to help. Now he is even more eager, because he trusts you so much.
As for Titus, he is my partner, and he works with me to help you. As for the brothers, they are sent by the churches, and they bring honour to Christ.
So show these men your love, and show them why we are proud of you, so that the churches can see it.
